embedded_etcd: vendored go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3 v3.7.1, single-member test-owned loopback server; UnsafeNoFsync
scope: N1/N6 real Pod REST+CacheDelegator+Cacher+JSON codec. N3 real production consumer initialization on fake client. N2 exact-output synthetic mechanism benchmark plus real-cache output gate. N4/N5 local HTTP production Pod GET/LIST/WATCH/UPDATE handlers and store/cache with embedded etcd and real client-go informer; whole measured process includes all these and excludes full control-plane filter chain. No general throughput claim.
construction: Server read/update routes use production handlers, defaulting and field manager; embedded server listens only locally
WatchListClient=false fixed in all harnesses; N3 DRAExtendedResource=true
N6 owns held initial backend List instead of using a helper that waits ready

hypotheses.N1: Exact same UID/RV HTTP/direct Pod values agree except declared outer GVK; informer/direct agree after managedFields trim. Omitted-codec fixture gains specific defaults. Cached source stays unchanged by returned result edits.
hypotheses.N2: Equal-output trimmed and retained groups pass independently. Output trim after direct conversion does not remove managedFields copy allocation slope.
hypotheses.N3: Cached wiring starts Pod informer; direct wiring without node graph does not; node graph keeps it. Other registered consumer prerequisites synchronize. PSA consumed adapter completes even with cancelled caller context.
hypotheses.N4: Direct elimination can reduce update-only allocations only when no event consumer remains; residual-event arm may preserve informer work and add read cost. This is an allocation mechanism experiment, not system throughput validation.
hypotheses.N5: Injected watch responses observed once only where informer exists; actual List and Watch receipts distinguish relist from resumed watch. A1/B/A2 identity/version and output checks pass.
hypotheses.N6: Before registration Get errors. Held-not-ready cache Get delegates once to backend; unbounded RV0 List returns TooManyRequests. Ready Get uses cache; bounded update/delete/recreate identity barriers pass. Getter falls back once on benign read errors and zero times on successful lister reads.

fixtures.codec_omitted_raw: v1 Pod JSON with UID codec-fixture, one pause container, omitted restartPolicy/dnsPolicy/schedulerName; injected directly at /followup/pods/ns/omitted and explicitly not labeled a supported HTTP write

N4N5.only_update: Pod annotation sequence via HTTP PUT; field manager uses deduced type converter, record resulting metadata

oracles.normalization: Only outer Pod TypeMeta and, in explicitly declared comparisons, metadata.managedFields; never mask spec/status/defaults
oracles.N1: Snapshot real Cacher.Get shallow-cache-owned nested fields plus unchanged subsequent reads; deliberately changed deep-copy snapshot must be detected
oracles.N3: Exact List/Watch route counts per resource, actual production setters and node graph handler construction; no admission/authorization outcome tests
oracles.N4: Strict full field equality before and after phase, per-read UID/RV/sequence equality, cache/informer RV barrier per update, exact HTTP update/read counts
oracles.N5: Cancel active fixture watch then inject exactly one EOF or ERROR Status Expired response on next watch; verify one injected response, subsequent live watch and catch-up

execution.order: Each block visits all factorial cells; reverse complete order on odd blocks; N2 reverse four-arm order on odd blocks. Separate test binary process for every arm/cell. No parallel trials.
execution.host_replication: Run identical source/protocol locally and GitHub ubuntu-latest; compare allocation medians separately and exact structural invariants. Timings remain per-host.

measurements: retained heap delta after prescribed single GC
HTTP response bytes, List/Watch/Update and storage Get counters
observed event updates and watch RVs
runner setup/build/execution/verification spans; preserve every launch

decisions.structural: KEEP bounded factual claims only when required oracles/control pass; BLOCKED evaluator or missing intended route; REVISE semantic differences rather than hiding them
decisions.N2: Median equal-output direct/cached bytes/op and retained/trimmed direct difference. No timing threshold; allocation effect must have same sign in at least 5 of 6 blocks to call robust on one host.
decisions.N4: A reduction claim requires direct/cached allocation ratio <=0.90 in at least 4 of 5 same-block matched cells plus median <=0.90. Harmful allocation effect uses ratio >=1.10 in >=4/5 and median >=1.10. Otherwise inconclusive/REVISE. Never turn wall-time variance into throughput claim.
decisions.N5: Structural recovery requires qualified perturbation counters and post-recovery equality. Report A2/A1 timing and within-10% as descriptive; no system hysteresis claim from short microphases. Allocation/GC peak/AUC not sampled continuously here and must remain NOT_MEASURED.
decisions.readiness: Before synchronization outcomes registered by stage; after barrier require identity/version agreement. Ready short operations may complete on already cancelled context; record exact bounded return/error instead of requiring an artificial cancellation failure.

limitations: N3 initializes actual consumers but does not run complete admission chain or graph authorization decisions
N2 timings are synthetic mechanism timings
N4 process totals include embedded etcd and harness work; modest finite workload and GC noise can make allocation ratio inconclusive
N4 update/read phases are sequential fixed-count microphases, not steady QPS capacity
N5 only WatchListClient=false and one bounded protocol perturbation; no transport stress, continuous peak/AUC or APF hysteresis claim
retain: All raw stdout/test2json, benchmark logs, manifest, source hashes, amendments, setup failures and independent verifier output; binaries in Actions artifact.
freeze_rule: Preregister source and protocol commit before measurements. Compile/calibration failure retained. Any changed assertions/fixtures/gates/runner must be committed as an amendment before new measures. Reruns never overwrite earlier attempt directories.
